newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.636 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.636 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.636 percent at its auction of 91-day treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 91-day treasury bills on July 18 also for 80 million ringgit, the average yield was 6.391 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.705/450 percent against 6.430/303 percent previously.
The central bank also said it accepted bids for 364-day treasury bills of 100 million ringgit at an average 6.459 percent against 6.361 percent on July 18.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.499/409 percent against 6.435/319 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 182-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on August 7.
